title: Leeto la Moya o o Amogetsweng
intro: Mo nakong ya fa ditlwaelo tsa setšhaba di ne di laola, motho yo o tlhomologileng o ne a itemogela phetogo e e tseneletseng mo teng ga lelapa le le segofaditsweng. Kgang ya bone, e e tshwailweng ka kgolagano ya lorato le taelo ya bomodimo, e bontsha go thubiwa ga dingwao tsa bogologolo le go tlhomiwa ga melaometheo e mesha, e e siameng. Kanelo eno e bontsha botlhokwa jwa boammaaruri go feta tumalano le botlhale jo bo mo ditaelong tsa ga Allah.
clues: Ke ne ke kile ka nna motshwarwa, mme ka thulaganyo ya bomodimo, ke ne ka bona legae le lelapa le lesha.

Ke ne ke ratiwa thata jaana mo e leng gore fa ke ne ke newa tlhopho fa gare ga lelapa la gaetsho la madi le motlhokomedi wa me yo ke neng ke mo godisitse, ke ne ka tlhopha go nna le lelapa la gaetsho la bofelo.
Leina la me le kile la amanngwa le motlhokomedi wa me yo ke mo godisitseng, e leng mokgwa o o neng o tlwaelegile mo setšhabeng sa gaetsho.
Ke nna fela molekane wa Moporofeti wa bofelo yo leina la gagwe le umakiwang ka tlhamalalo ke Allah mo Quran.
Ke ne ka nyala mosadi mongwe wa maemo a a kwa godimo yo e neng e le ntsalae Moporofeti, mme lenyalo la rona ga le a ka la nnela ruri.
Morago ga tlhalo ya me, Allah ka boene o ne a laela gore mosadi wa me wa pele o tla nyala Moporofeti, ka jalo a dira gore ngwao ya bogologolo e e malebana le go godisa ngwana e nne lefela.

trial.answer: Taelo ya bomodimo e e malebana le lenyalo la me le tlhalo

outcome.answer: Go fedisiwa ga mokgwa wa pele ga Boiselamo wa ‘go bitsa barwa ba ba godisitsweng jaaka barwa ba madi’.

arabic: وَإِذْ تَقُولُ لِلَّذِىٓ أَنْعَمَ ٱللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَأَنْعَمْتَ عَلَيْهِ أَمْسِكْ عَلَيْكَ زَوْجَكَ وَٱتَّقِ ٱللَّهَ وَتُخْفِى فِى نَفْسِكَ مَا ٱللَّهُ مُبْدِيهِ وَتَخْشَى ٱلنَّاسَ وَٱللَّهُ أَحَقُّ أَن تَخْشَىٰهُ ۖ فَلَمَّا قَضَىٰ زَيْدٌۭ مِّنْهَا وَطَرًۭا زَوَّجْنَـٰكَهَا لِكَىْ لَا يَكُونَ عَلَى ٱلْمُؤْمِنِينَ حَرَجٌۭ فِىٓ أَزْوَٰجِ أَدْعِيَآئِهِمْ إِذَا قَضَوْا۟ مِنْهُنَّ وَطَرًۭا ۚ وَكَانَ أَمْرُ ٱللَّهِ مَفْعُولًۭا
verse: And [remember, O Muḥammad], when you said to the one on whom Allāh bestowed favor and you bestowed favor, "Keep your wife and fear Allāh," while you concealed within yourself that which Allāh is to disclose. And you feared the people, while Allāh has more right that you fear Him. So when Zayd had no longer any need for her, We married her to you in order that there not be upon the believers any discomfort [i.e., guilt] concerning the wives of their claimed [i.e., adopted] sons when they no longer have need of them. And ever is the command [i.e., decree] of Allāh accomplished. (33:37)
